name: Not a Saint
source:
She's used to having everyone at her feet until a cold, distant stranger awakes her interest. In lust-filled mind games, the outcome can only be complicated.

(https://www.vienna-hale.com/episode-interactive)
translation:
她向来习惯了众星捧月、人人拜倒在自己石榴裙下，直到一个冷漠疏离的陌生男人挑起了她的兴致。在这场充满情欲张力的心理博弈中，结局注定不会简单。

[摘自https://www.vienna-hale.com/episode-interactive]
